senses.gloss:
तोरण mn. (-णः-णं)
 1. The ornamented arch of a door or gateway.
 2. An
outer door.
 3. Decoration of the gate-post.
 3. A temporary and
ornamented arch.
 5. A mound or raised mark near a bathing
place.
 6. A triangle supporting a large balance.
 n. (-णं) The neck,
[]
the throat.
 E. तुर् to hasten, affix आधारे ल्युट्; by which people
pass or go.
